text:
Alex (AE): Heads-up — FinLedger signed the term sheet and wants a POC next week. They asked for a sizing recommendation and a cost estimate for a committed pool + burst. Peak traffic estimate: 550 concurrent requests, avg prompt 350 tokens, p95 latency target 250ms. Can we sketch a preheat + fallback plan?
Priya (Solutions Eng): Congrats! Need a couple of clarifying Qs: are those 550 concurrent infer requests across chat completions or embedding calls? Also expected qps vs sustained rps?
Tina (FinLedger - PM): Mostly chat completions (multi-turn). Profile: steady 120 rps baseline, 550 rps spikes up to ~3 minutes during batch jobs, avg tokens per request ~350, but some customers send up to 1,200 tokens.
Marcus (Platform SRE): For that profile I’d recommend reserved pool to cover baseline + autoscale for spikes. Rough calc: baseline 120 rps -> ~2 dedicated A100s if model is 7B quantized; spikes to 550 rps -> need burst capacity (shared burst or spot). We should consider a preheat window to warm KV caches.
Sam (Pricing): Important: reserved pricing is monthly commit. We'll need to map predicted peak minutes to effective GPU-hours to quote burst credits. Ask: how many minutes/day of spikes?
Tina (FinLedger - PM): Spikes ~20-40 minutes total per day, not contiguous. Some end-of-day batch runs cause ~5 spike windows.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Ok. Two-pronged plan: 1) Reserve capacity sized for ~1.5x baseline to hit p95 at baseline; 2) Autoscale + burst credits for short spikes; 3) Canary policy to fall back to a smaller quantized variant if autoscale can't catch up. Also suggest input rate limiting on client side for big prompts.
Marcus (Platform SRE): Example autoscale policy we can deploy in POC: 
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  target_latency_ms: 180
  min_gpus: 1
  baseline_gpus: 2
  max_gpus: 8
  burst_mode:
    enabled: true
    burst_credits: 2000
    cooldown_s: 120
  fallback_sequence:
    - model: redwood-7b-quantized
    - model: redwood-3b-quantized
```
This gives headroom for your 3-minute spikes. We should test with a synthetic spikebench.
Alex (AE): Two asks for pricing/contract: what's the committed pool size we should propose in proposal, and what's the hourly burst price we include as optional?
Sam (Pricing): Suggest commit = baseline_gpus * 720h * months. If we reserve 2 GPUs for baseline, quote 2-GPU reserved monthly with burst credits block priced at 0.35x of on-demand GPU per credit. I'll run numbers and post a draft.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Operational checklist for POC: load profile JSON, sample prompts (short, medium, long), canary rollout plan, perf telemetry (token latency, KV hit rate), and a security questionnaire completion timeline.
Tina (FinLedger - PM): Security Q still outstanding — their infosec asked about KMS integration, audit logs retention, and private VPC option. They said whole security review must be done before production commit.
Marcus (Platform SRE): For KMS + audit logs we can meet them: KMS via customer-managed key in Private, audit logs via Console with 90-day retention (extendable). We'll note network requirements for VPC peering and certs.
Alex (AE): Can someone create an internal ticket for the security questionnaire and tag ENG-SRE + Legal? Tina — can you paste the specific questionnaire items here so we can triage?
Tina (FinLedger - PM): Pasting top asks they flagged: 1) KMS/HSM support 2) SOC2 controls mapping 3) Data residency in eu-west-1 4) Access logs and retention 5) Vulnerability scan cadence. I'll DM the full PDF.
OpsBot: Created ticket #INC-5421 for FinLedger security questionnaire and assigned to eng-security, eng-sre, and legal.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Next steps for POC: I can run a capacity test using our sim harness on Tues 09:00 PT. Marcus — can you provision baseline 2 GPUs in dedicated pool and enable burst credits in the test account?
Marcus (Platform SRE): I’ll provision on Mon and attach a burst pool. I’ll also set up a canary route that falls back to redwood-3b-quantized when p95 > 300ms for 30s.
Sam (Pricing): Draft quote: 2 reserved GPUs monthly + 2000 burst credits = preliminary $Xk/mo. I'll share spreadsheet by EOD.
Alex (AE): Great. Priya — please schedule the sim and share the load profile. Tina — we'll loop in Security and Legal after OpsBot ticket. Any blocker? :thumbsup:
Tina (FinLedger - PM): No blockers from our side right now. Thanks all. :handshake:
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll post the sim link and test checklist here once ready. :eyes:
